definitions.explanation: The act of waking up early in the morning. Can also describe a person who habitually wakes up early. Functions as a noun and as a suru-verb.

examples.japanese: {早起|はやお}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三文|さんもん}→三文：28481_sanmon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{徳|とく}→徳：23014_toku⟧。
examples.english: The early bird catches the worm.
examples.notes: Famous proverb (lit. 'early rising is worth three mon')

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{早起|はやお}きし⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: I have to wake up early tomorrow.
I like getting up early and going for a walk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{早起|はやお}きし⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦ゆうべ→ゆうべ：02487_yuube⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{寝|ね}た→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: Since I have to get up early on the day of the trip, I went to bed early last night.

notes:
Can be used as a noun ({早起|はやお}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧ = good at getting up early) or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ({早起|はやお}きする = wake up early).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {早起|はやお}きする (wake up early)
- {早起|はやお}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三文|さんもん}→三文：28481_sanmon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{徳|とく}→徳：23014_toku⟧ (proverb: early rising is beneficial)
- {早起|はやお}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧ (bad at getting up early)

Opposite: ⟦{朝寝坊|あさねぼう}→朝寝坊：02516_asanebou⟧ (oversleeping, late riser)
